systems.country_label: microplanification de la vaccination de routine (Programme Élargi de Vaccination)
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population, with technical support from HISP
systems.tiers: health districts of Health Region No. 5 (workshops at Ndélé 2-5 March 2026 and Bria 7-11 March 2026); microplans drawn up for each health facility; coordination across district, regional and central levels

note: The only system described is immunisation microplanning in DHIS2, one function and not routine reporting of patients treated nor a patient record, so it gives no hmis or emr fact.
